Both specs are in the earlier layout, so they need small in-place edits and no new behaviour ids. Neither names a review unit. I searched `plugins/temperspec-tgraph/docs/specs/` for `code_join`, `outcome gate` and `outcome_gate`. I read `overview.spec.md` and `code-join.spec.md` in full. I did not read `outcome-gate.spec.md` in full or any code.

`ARTIFACT gap_finding: overview.spec.md and code-join.spec.md (both read in full) name no review unit and need the unit added; outcome-gate.spec.md (grep only) has no path picture. overview.spec.md is in the earlier layout ("## 1. Overview", "## 6. Acceptance criteria"), so edits stay in that layout. Its "Units:" list is lines 7-26, one line per unit of the form "- [name](file.spec.md): description", in run order and ending at line 26 "- [code_join](code-join.spec.md): Where both arms meet after the code step". A review unit line goes after line 26 and links the new unit spec. Line 28 lists the specs beside the units (judge reading, outcome gate, code mode and others) and also names code_mode. code-join.spec.md line 5 says the unit "passes the run on to the outcome gate" and that it has "no session, gate, check or effect". That line must say the run goes on to the review unit, and the review unit then passes it to the outcome gate, with or without a skip. Line 7 ("Part of the overview") and line 11 ("None: a join has no gate criteria") need no change. outcome-gate.spec.md has no path picture. Its OGT-B1 to B11 only reference "the path" of a run (full discovery, short visit, plan step, code step). Its routing sends a failing criterion back to those steps (lines 50-67) and never names a unit between code_join and the gate. Nothing there says the review unit is skipped or taken, so any change is optional. The triage claim that the outcome gate's picture must show the unit rests on code-join.spec.md line 5 and the overview, not on outcome-gate.spec.md. AC 10 also asks for the README and diagram to show the unit; I did not search for those.`
